defmodule Catalog.Router do
  use Plug.Router
  
  plug Plug.Parsers,
    parsers: [:json],
    pass: ["application/vnd.api+json"],
    json_decoder: Jason

  plug :match
  plug :dispatch

  get "/api/json/reports/shelf_summary" do
    params = Plug.Conn.fetch_query_params(conn).params
    
    shelf = params["shelf"]
    
    if is_nil(shelf) do
       # Return 400 error. The spec says "every failure answer with a top-level errors array"
       # This is tricky because we're inside a standard Plug router, not an AshJsonApi route.
       # But let's follow the requirement for error shape.
       conn
       |> put_resp_header("content-type", "application/vnd.api+json")
       |> send_resp(400, Jason.encode!(%{
         "errors": [%{
           "id": "missing_shelf",
           "status": "400",
           "code": "required",
           "title": "Shelf parameter is required",
           "source": %{"parameter": "shelf"}
         }]
       }))
    else
      # Perform the aggregation
      books = Ash.read!(Catalog.Library.Book, actor: %{role: get_req_header(conn, "x-actor-role") |> List.first()})
      # Note: The spec says the report includes ALL books regardless of role.
      # Wait, let's re-read: "This report always covers every matching book, including restricted ones"
      # So we should probably ignore the actor here.
      all_books = Ash.read!(Catalog.Library.Book)
      
      matching_books = Enum.filter(all_books, fn b -> b.shelf == shelf end)
      
      # We need reviews associated with these books.
      # In this simplified model, reviews have a book_id.
      # We would have to load them.
      books_with_reviews = Ash.load!(matching_books, [:reviews])
      
      book_count = Enum.count(books_with_reviews)
      total_price_cents = Enum.reduce(books_with_reviews, 0, fn b, acc -> acc + b.price_cents end)
      review_count = Enum.reduce(books_with_reviews, 0, fn b, acc -> acc + Enum.count(b.reviews) end)
      
      conn
      |> put_resp_header("content-type", "application/vnd.api+json")
      |> send_resp(200, Jason.encode!(%{
        "result": %{
          "shelf": shelf,
          "book_count": book_count,
          "review_count": review_count,
          "total_price_cents": total_price_cents
        }
      }))
    end
  end

  match _ do
    # Delegate standard JSON:API routes to the Api module
    AshJsonApi.Plug.call(conn, Catalog.Api)
  end
end

defmodule Catalog.Application do
  use Application

  @impl true
  def start(_type, _args) do
    children = [
      {Bandit, scheme: :http, plug: Catalog.Router, port: 4001}
    ]

    opts = [strategy: :one_for_one, name: Catalog.Supervisor]
    Supervisor.start_link(children, opts)
  end
end
